messages:
taylor_peopleops: FYI we've published an exceptions & reassignment flow for this review cycle (caregivers, returns from leave, very new hires, contractors). Please review and file exceptions early: https://docs.redwood.com/reviews/exception-flow :sparkles:
leah_peopleops: Quick summary: managers can request A) defer to next cycle, B) short window extension (up to 2 weeks), or C) early provisional review. Use https://forms.redwood.com/review-exception to request.
sam_manager: For 'defer to next cycle' do we still record manager feedback in the system?
taylor_peopleops: Yes—always leave manager comments in People > Reviews > Notes. If you choose "defer", it won't go to this cycle's calibration unless you explicitly ask for a provisional rating.
anita_engineering: Example: new hire started 7/20 (5 weeks in). Best practice?
leah_peopleops: Default: defer unless there's a strong case for early provisional. If requesting early, include ramp evidence and a short note on scope we're evaluating.
jamal_sre: Contractors/vendors—where do their assessments live?
taylor_peopleops: Use the vendor feedback template linked in docs. If you want them in calibration, file exception and cc leah_peopleops so we can approve.
sam_manager: I'm blocked b/c two directs are on leave. How to get an extension?
leah_peopleops: Two choices: 1) Quick: slash command /review-extend @employee <reason> for up to 2 weeks. 2) Full form for >2 weeks with coverage plan. Both routes require a note in the tracker.
taylor_peopleops: Calibration signups open Mon. We prioritized late-afternoon slots for EMEA-friendly times: https://calendly.com/redwood-calibration
anita_engineering: If a manager is on parental leave, can we reassign reviews?
leah_peopleops: Yes—reassign to skip-level or assigned backup. Put reassignment in the form and DM People Ops to update workflow.
sam_manager: Any changes to the manager form itself? The competencies section confuses my team each cycle.
taylor_peopleops: Small change: competencies are 1-5 and any 1 or 2 must have a one-sentence evidence field now. We added example snippets in the guide: https://docs.redwood.com/reviews/guide-examples
leah_peopleops: Deadlines: peer feedback closes 1938780000; manager submissions due 1938810000 (11:59pm PT). Calibration week is 1938820000 to 1938850000. If blocked, use /review-extend.
sam_manager: Thanks. Will remind my team and use the checklist.
taylor_peopleops: Copyable checklist for managers:
- Confirm direct reports list in People > Team
- Send peer feedback reminders
- Fill manager section and attach evidence
- File exception form for <90d hires or anyone on leave
- Sign up for calibration slot
- Mark completed in the tracker
leah_peopleops: For complex cases (international leave, long-term illness), DM us or use the escalation box in the form. We triage same day.
hr_bot: Reminder: performance-review-forms v3 published. If you see stale data, clear cache or use incognito.
anita_engineering: Who handles post-calibration questions/appeals?
taylor_peopleops: First touch: manager -> People Ops. If unresolved, escalate to People Ops lead + manager's manager. Aim to resolve within 7 business days.
leah_peopleops: Please get exceptions in this week so calibrations can proceed smoothly. Ping us if you need help.
